title: Local LLM credential onboarding + offline sync sketch
content:
Purpose:
- Very rough sketch for how a local / edge LLM client (mobile/desktop/embedded) can: onboard with Redwood backend, obtain short-lived credentials for inference, persist a minimal checkpoint for offline use, and rotate/refresh credentials when reconnected.
- Focus: minimize blast radius if device compromised, support offline inference windows (minutes->hours), allow graceful rollback if model or policy changes.

Assumptions and constraints:
- Clients have intermittent connectivity; cannot rely on continuous heartbeat.
- Devices run a lightweight runtime that can store a small encrypted KV store (config + checkpoints + ephemeral keys).
- Server (Redwood private control plane or hosted API) will mint ephemeral tokens scoped to: model_id, max_tokens, allowed_endpoints, expiration, and optionally revocation_id.
- We prefer short TTLs (minutes) for live inference, but to support offline windows we allow a cached offline token wrapping an encrypted offline-key that can be used locally for N uses or until a time cap.

Design primitives (v0):
1) Device identity: device_id (UUID), device_pubkey (ED25519) created at onboarding. Stored in secure enclave if available.
2) Onboarding flow: user signs in (oauth/sso) or device authorized via provisioning token (from enterprise admin).
3) Minting endpoints: /v1/onboard -> returns provisioning_token OR finalizes device registration; /v1/mint-ephemeral -> returns ephemeral_jwt and offline_blob metadata; /v1/validate-checkpoint -> server-side validation of checkpoint against policy.

API sketches (payloads intentionally informal):
- POST /v1/onboard
  body: {"device_id": "uuid", "device_pubkey": "base64", "user_id": "u-123" , "provisioning_token": "opt" }
  resp: {"device_record_id":"dr-55","device_cert":"signed-by-RW","default_scopes": ["text:generate"], "next_steps": ["mint-ephemeral"]}

- POST /v1/mint-ephemeral
  headers: Authorization: Bearer <user_token_or_provisioning>
  body: {"device_record_id":"dr-55","model":"rw-7b-v2","offline_window_sec":3600, "max_local_uses": 100}
  resp: {
    "ephemeral_token": "jwt.b64...",
